approval_ref: The active user goal explicitly assigns local file, project, task, version, result, citation and review management to CRIP around an advanced-model reference implementation.
notes: Keep legacy analysis and Ask the project bound to legacy knowledge.
Reference preparation, preview, result reads and review must make zero model calls.
Persist only validated public decisions and citations, never hidden model reasoning or image bytes.
Use an additive migration; do not read or modify .local customer data during tests.
No live provider request or fixed customer benchmark is authorized by this task.
title: Add the managed Reference QA workspace
objective: Make Reference QA a separate browser workflow and persist every validated terminal result, normalized citation and optimistic-lock human review event locally without changing legacy product paths.
